categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in manufacturing and selling electric wires and cables, including ultra-high voltage (345kV), high and medium voltage cables, low voltage cables, and rubber cables. It also engages in electrical installation, wholesale and retail of electrical equipment, international trade, battery manufacturing, cogeneration, renewable energy self-generation equipment, and consulting services. The company serves government agencies, electric power companies, and other cable manufacturers, focusing on power transmission and distribution systems.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced manufacturing technologies such as 400kV ultra-high voltage dry-type cross-linked polyethylene (XLPE) cable production equipment imported from Finland. It uses cleanroom production environments (Class 1000) and automated smart manufacturing systems for real-time monitoring and quality control. The company develops eco-friendly, low-smoke, halogen-free (LSFH) materials and focuses on innovations in energy storage cables, high-voltage direct current (HVDC) cables, and rubber cable production processes with reduced environmental impact.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include Taiwan Power Company (Taipower), government agencies, private power plants, renewable energy developers, and electrical engineering contractors. The company mainly serves the Taiwanese domestic market with some sales to Japan. It targets sectors such as power generation, transmission, distribution, industrial facilities, and emerging green energy markets including energy storage and electric vehicle charging infrastructure.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates in Taiwan, with major sales concentrated domestically (over 99% of revenue). It also exports a small portion of products internationally, including to Japan. The company is expanding its market presence in emerging markets such as Vietnam and aims to participate in global green energy infrastructure development.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the electric power cable supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and supplying high-quality cables and related electrical equipment. It also extends downstream by providing installation, engineering, and testing services. Upstream raw materials such as copper and insulating polymers are procured from multiple suppliers to ensure stable supply.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include developing green energy-related cable products such as energy storage cables, high-voltage direct current (HVDC) cables, and electric vehicle charging cables. The company emphasizes sustainability through ESG initiatives, carbon reduction, and circular economy practices. R&D focuses on enhancing cable performance, environmental compatibility, and smart manufacturing technologies to support Taiwan's energy transition and net-zero carbon goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of electric wires, cables, and related electrical equipment. Additional income comes from engineering services, installation contracts, and international trade activities. The company also benefits from government infrastructure projects and private sector contracts in the energy and industrial sectors.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of only four certified suppliers in Taiwan qualified to produce 345kV ultra-high voltage cables for Taipower, positioning it as a leading player in the domestic high-voltage cable market. It competes with a limited number of specialized cable manufacturers, leveraging advanced technology and certifications to maintain competitive advantages. Its strong reputation and product quality support its market share of approximately 5.89% in Taiwan's cable industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company achieved significant growth in 2023 with consolidated revenue reaching approximately NT$5.48 billion, a 30% increase from the previous year, and net profit after tax of NT$730 million, up 79%. Total assets grew by 19% to NT$6.4 billion, and equity increased by nearly 70% to NT$2.53 billion. The company has expanded capital through public offerings and increased long-term borrowings to support capacity expansion and smart manufacturing investments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, certified cable products with superior insulation, durability, and environmental performance, including low-smoke halogen-free materials. It offers comprehensive solutions from cable manufacturing to installation and testing, supporting critical infrastructure projects such as Taipower's resilient grid plan. Its commitment to sustainability, innovation in green energy cables, and smart production processes differentiate it as a reliable partner in Taiwan's energy transition.
